additional_sensitivity.only_executable_mutation: Commit exact dirty-token retirement before the separate frame transaction.
additional_sensitivity.control_behavior: Inject after-retirement exception, reconstruct a new object/connection/cache with the same surviving provider, continue from durable cursor and drain, then compare every independently decoded committed frame with source/native rows.
additional_sensitivity.observed_result: Original control passes; isolated omission fails exactly at complete decoded/native equality. No import/setup/timeout failures are accepted.
additional_sensitivity.interpretation: In this schedule, committing retirement before the frame transaction leaves no obligation for key10 after its frame rolls back. The final complete comparison exposes the resulting loss. This is finite sensitivity evidence, not an unbounded atomicity or process-crash proof.
